modules.description: ArkTS Expo Module classes exported by the conventional Harmony library.

services.description: ArkTS service classes exported by the conventional Harmony library. Classes extend ExpoService and accept an ExpoServiceContext constructor argument.

appLifecycleSubscribers.description: Process-owned native subscriber classes extending ExpoAppLifecycleSubscriber, constructed with ApplicationContext before RN initialization. Declaration order is preserved.

abilityLifecycleSubscribers.description: UIAbility-owned native subscriber classes extending ExpoAbilityLifecycleSubscriber, constructed with UIAbilityContext independently of ExpoModule and RN runtime lifetimes. Declaration order is preserved.
